_description: Transfer patterns in the synthetic dataset and their graph-analytics implications.

P1_STAR.description: CLI-001 (CTA-001) fans out to CLI-002, CLI-003, CLI-004, CLI-005, CLI-006
P1_STAR.expected_property: CLI-001 has high out_degree; these 4 clients become immediate counterparties

P2_CHAIN.expected_property: CLI-002 acts as relay node with both in-edge (from C01) and out-edge (to C03)

P3_CYCLE.expected_property: Cycle detection algorithm should flag this pair

P4_HUB_IN.description: CLI-001, CLI-002, CLI-003 all send to CLI-006
P4_HUB_IN.expected_property: CLI-006 has in_degree=3 from hub pattern; high PageRank expected

P5_INTERMEDIARY.expected_property: CLI-007 is an intermediary: betweenness centrality > 0

P6_MULTI_TX.description: Three separate CTA-002 → CTA-003 transfers (same account pair)
P6_MULTI_TX.expected_property: Transfers are NOT deduplicated; all three appear as distinct TRANSFIERE_A edges

P7_CANCELLED.expected_property: Must not produce active TRANSFIERE_A edges in the graph

P8_POST_CUTOFF.expected_property: Must be rejected by the temporal validation rule (TRF-Q05)
